collection.title: Vauxhall Astra Coupe 2005 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Astra Coupe 2005 to 2010 requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
